name: 19085-decode-32b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-32B-FP8. Public and ungated, ~33 GB of FP8 weights on disk.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine (guidellm `vllm_python`), no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, bounded at 512 requests with a 6.35% warmup -> 32 warmup and 480 measured, no cooldown, safety_seconds 3600 as a runaway guard.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, exactly 100 prompt and 100 output tokens (min == max on both), greedy at temperature 0.0, `request_format: plain` so no chat template is applied, prefix caching off, and `ignore_eos` set so every request emits exactly 100 tokens. Seed 19085.
purpose: A 32-billion-parameter assistant generating fixed 100-token replies to short prompts for 16 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-32B-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 2048
# RUNNER HAZARD: the in-process backend skips the `vllm serve` usage-context default
# table, so unpinned these two fall through to 2048 / 256.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024
enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
